title: Full decoding of the destiny matrix: twenty sections of the chart

seo.title: Destiny matrix: the full decoding
seo.description: What a full decoding covers: twenty sections, from character and the centre to money, relationships, family line and the decades up to eighty.

short: A full decoding reads every meaningful point of the chart, not just one of them. In the Arcana Sense reading it is laid out as twenty sections: each answers its own question and rests on its own points, so the sections never retell one another.

sections.h2: What the full reading is made of
paragraphs: The first sections answer the question “what am I like”: character and personal qualities from the three outer points, the centre of the chart and the inner points of the vertical axis. After that come the areas: profession and the line of talent, the path of self-realisation, the karmic task up to forty, what unlocks your reserve of strength, the gifts of the family line, the tasks of the soul.

Next comes what people usually open the chart for in the first place: money and the money line, how income changes after forty, relationships, the karma of relations with parents and children, family tasks down to the seventh generation, purpose on four levels.

Closing the reading are the tasks of past lives, the body’s reserve of strength and how it comes back, the energy map across the seven chakras, the kind of rest that suits you, recurring programs and a reading by decades up to eighty.

sections.h2: Why twenty sections and not one long text
paragraphs: Because each section reads its own points. Money is counted along the money line, relationships along the line of relationships, the family line along its four branches. Merging them into a single story would mean averaging them: the result would hang together, but say nothing definite about any one area.

For the same reason the sections do not retell one another. The same number, landing in two different areas, is described differently in each of them, and that very difference is what carries the meaning.

sections.h2: What opens at once and what sits in the reading
paragraphs: Building the chart is free and needs no sign-up. Two sections — character and the centre — open straight away: they answer the question “what am I like” and ask for no payment at all.

The other eighteen sections make up the full reading: money, relationships, purpose, the family line, the decades and the rest. The reading is printed on request and stays available in your personal account.

sections.h2: In what order to read the full reading
paragraphs: Not straight through. Character and the centre first — they set the frame of reference. Then the section the chart was opened for. The rest are better read one at a time, with a gap between them: the reading describes steady leanings, and they are easier to recognise when you check them against episodes that already happened, rather than reading twenty sections in one evening.
The reading by decades is worth leaving until the very end: it reads much more easily once it is already clear to you which points each ten-year period of a life is put together from.

faq.q: What does a full decoding of the destiny matrix include?
faq.a: Twenty sections: character, the centre and the inner points, profession, self-realisation, the karmic task, your reserve of strength, the gifts of the family line, the tasks of the soul, past lives, purpose, money, money after forty, relationships, karma with parents and children, family tasks, the body’s reserve of strength, chakras, rest, programs and the decades.

faq.q: What is available free of charge?
faq.a: The chart itself, plus two sections of the reading — character and personal qualities, and the centre with the inner points. The other eighteen belong to the full reading.

faq.q: Why are there so many sections?
faq.a: Each one reads its own points of the chart: money along the money line, relationships along the line of relationships, the family line along its four branches. Putting them together would mean averaging them and losing the detail.

faq.q: In what order should the sections be read?
faq.a: Character and the centre first — they set the frame of reference, then whichever section you came for. The rest are best taken one at a time, checked against episodes that already happened.
